candidates.title: The time-dependent simulation of CFETR baseline steady-state scenarios
candidates.notes: Liu et al., USTC/PPPL/ASIPP. Open PDF via OSTI purl (3.6MB). Contains quantitative H&CD scenario analysis: three scenarios (NB+EC, NB+LH, LH+EC), current drive efficiencies for EC and LH, NB deposition and shine-through, ramp-up H&CD requirements. CFETR Phase I at 200 MW fusion power, 10 MA, R=5.7m. Directly addresses G-11.

entries.notes: OSTI CFETR steady-state scenarios paper extracted successfully. Covers H&CD portfolio (NBI + EC + LH scenarios) with quantitative current drive efficiencies and power levels. candidates.title: The ARIES Advanced and Conservative Tokamak Power Plant Study (ARIES-AT full report, OSTI 1178069)
candidates.notes: OSTI open-access PDF. ARIES-AT is the best published CAS-level cost analogue for a conventional-AR D-T tokamak (R0=5.2m, B0=5.6T, 1000 MWe, COE 4.7 c/kWh). Parameters closely analogous to PFPP commercial target. Directly addresses cost structure needed for PFPP capital cost estimation.

The gap is partially addressed through the analogue approach; Chinese-specific costs still missing.
